rd_error_duplicate: A redirect for this URL already exists.
rd_error_self_redirect: The destination cannot be the same as the source.
rd_error_invalid: Please fill in both the source and destination.
rd_add_hint: When a visitor requests the source URL, they are sent to the destination instead. Use 301 for a permanent move (transfers SEO ranking) or 302 for a temporary one.
rd_fallback_hint: When a visitor reaches a page that no longer exists and no redirect above matches, send them to the homepage instead of the theme's 404 page. Always temporary (302) — it never tells search engines the homepage replaced the missing page.
rd_fallback_checkbox: Redirect unresolved 404 pages to the homepage
